title: Criteria are scored only from measured campaign evidence that resolves
user_story: As the owner I want the objectives file to change only from measured results, never from claims, so an L3 statement is earned (agent/PLAN_6.6.4_L3.md B5).

requirements.description: qualification.score marks a criterion QUALIFIED only when every planned case measured and passed it with evidence resolving to its sha256 inside the campaign folder; any failure is NOT_QUALIFIED, missing or changed evidence INCONCLUSIVE, nothing measured NOT_RUN; RQ-13 needs the suite digest and every case attempted; RQ-14 needs zero rescue and risk exceptions; L3 needs all 14.
qualification.apply writes status, evidence and the campaign's sha256 into the objectives file from a scored campaign only.

inputs: campaign record JSON and its evidence files
outputs: per-criterion status, reasons, evidence refs, achieved_level
acceptance_criteria: The repository's objectives file is unchanged (L3 not demonstrated)

scenarios.expected: All measured and passed: scoped L3 with denominators
One failed case disqualifies and is named
A missing measurement or changed evidence is inconclusive
Evidence outside the campaign folder never counts
Human rescue disqualifies RQ-14; no suite digest or missing cases disqualify RQ-13
An empty campaign is NOT_RUN everywhere (scoring is pure file reads)
apply writes measured status and the campaign hash into a copy; the repository file is untouched

recovery: Fix at qualification.score/apply; never write a status that was not measured. TASK-QUALIFICATION-664, max three cycles.
test_environment: Temporary campaign folders with real evidence files; a copy of the objectives file; evidence in docs/qa/evidence/qualification-664/.

tdd.scope: RED: 7 tests on 8f0516a, all failing (no scoring module). GREEN: 7/7.
